children: Sept 28 (Reuters) – Details of the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas' Texas monthly manufacturing index released on Monday. Following are details from the survey.Only some items are seasonally adjusted:

September        August                                                 Index         IndexProduction                                        29.5          16.1Capacity Utilization                              23.9          12.8New Orders                                        30.7          22.0Growth Rate of Orders                             19.1           8.1Unfilled Orders                                   22.7          -1.3Shipments                                         24.8          14.1Delivery Time                                     17.5          12.5Finished Goods Inventories                        -9.5           2.9Prices Paid for Raw Materials                     52.2          44.1Prices Received for Finished Goods                27.6          22.7Wages and Benefits                                27.4          21.1Employment                                        15.1           8.0Hours Worked                                       5.6           5.9Capital Expenditures                               8.5           8.2General Business ConditionsCompany Outlook                                    8.7          19.2General Business Activity                          9.8          11.6
NOTES: The index measures Texas' factory activity. Readings above zero indicate expansion and negative levels contraction. ((U.S. Treasury desk; Tel: + 1 202 898 8310))
